description.ENG: Create class PhoneBook with methods add_number(name, number) and get_number(name). Store data in a dictionary.
description.CAS: Crea clase PhoneBook con métodos add_number y get_number.
description.EUS: Sortu PhoneBook klasea add_number eta get_number metodoekin.

blocks.testCode:
import unittest
class TestPhoneBook(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        pb = PhoneBook()
        pb.add_number("Eric", "123")
        self.assertEqual(pb.get_number("Eric"), "123")
        self.assertIsNone(pb.get_number("Alice"))
